launch_doors._comment: How a worker is reached, per runtime. Two doors: a subagent inside the current CLI, and a headless CLI started from bash with a given model. 'verified' lines were run once on the date shown (ticket 1063/1064 logs); 'unverified' lines were not run and are not to be trusted until they are.

subagent.form: Agent tool with a per-launch model token (haiku|sonnet|opus|fable); Workflow agent() inherits the session model unless opts set otherwise
subagent.pin: Pin the model on EVERY launch. Frontmatter 'model: standard|strong' tokens in agents/*.md are sent to the API verbatim and return HTTP 404; a per-launch model overrides them. An unpinned general-purpose launch inherits the session model.

families: any provider configured in the host's Pi
headless.note: Author 2026-10-08: Anthropic API credits for Max-plan owners are coming, so Pi can call Anthropic once the Claude weekly limit is exhausted. Wrapper ~/.local/bin/pi-haiku (host-local, not in the repo) runs Pi on anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 only and refuses --model/--provider/--models/--api-key overrides, so no costlier model is reachable through it; the key is read from ~/.config/keys/anthropic.env into that process only. Tested 2026-10-08: overrides refused, key authenticates, call returns HTTP 400 credit balance too low (no credits yet). Do not route to it until a call succeeds. Configured providers differ per host.
